questions.question: Clarify whether 1767 is the publication year of “On the Solution of Numerical Equations”.
questions.resolution: Clarified: the paper belonged to the Academy’s 1767 volume but was published in 1769. Source: https://archive.numdam.org/articles/10.24033/rhm.69/
